title: Faith That Defies All Odds
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful and personal testimony of God's faithfulness and healing in the life of his father. Through a series of remarkable circumstances, Pastor Zehner's family witnessed God's supernatural intervention in his father's life, bringing restoration and renewal in the midst of dire medical conditions. This sermon is a testament to the Lord's goodness and a reminder that He is always at work in our lives, even in the darkest of times.
